paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score performance over training epochs for three distinct data subsets: “Regular members,” “Members with near-duplicates,” and “Held-out data.” The x-axis, labeled “Epochs,” spans from 0 to 3.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.5, indicating a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU score,” ranges from 0.00 to 0.35, with major gridlines and tick labels every 0.05, also on a linear scale. The “Regular members” line, rendered in solid blue, begins near 0.02 at epoch 0, rises gradually to approximately 0.05 by epoch 1.0, and then plateaus with minor fluctuations around 0.06–0.07 through epoch 3.0. The “Members with near-duplicates” line, shown in solid orange, starts near 0.02, climbs steeply to 0.10 by epoch 0.5, continues rising to 0.25 by epoch 1.5, peaks near 0.35 at epoch 2.5, and ends slightly higher at approximately 0.36 by epoch 3.0. The “Held-out data” line, depicted in solid green, begins near 0.03, rises slightly to 0.04 by epoch 0.5, then remains relatively flat with small oscillations between 0.03 and 0.04 through epoch 3.0. All lines are connected with solid lines and no markers, and a legend in the upper right corner identifies each group by color and label.
